recommendation.headline: Approve repair with adjustments: remove two unsupported front-end lines ($364), add two required ADAS calibration/scan operations ($375), and pursue subrogation against at-fault driver's carrier for full recovery including the $500 deductible.
recommendation.incident_summary: On 2026-10-03 at 17:42, insured Maya Okafor's 2022 Honda Accord EX (VIN SYN1HGCV1F3XN000817) was struck from behind while stopped at a red light at Harbor Ave & 5th St, Fairview, OH by a 2019 Nissan Rogue driven by Derek Sloan. Fairview PD cited Sloan for following too closely (FPD-26-11873). No injuries were reported. The vehicle was drivable and delivered to DRP partner Northgate Collision Center on 2026-10-06, where estimate EST-81731 was written. Liability against the insured's policy is not at issue; third-party carrier Granite Ridge Auto Insurance (claim GR-7731-0045) has not yet accepted liability.

coverage_position.explanation: Policy LMI-PA-4471920 is active (effective 2026-03-01, paid in full), collision coverage is present with a $500 deductible, and Maya Okafor is a listed driver operating the listed vehicle. The coverage_check returns first_party_verdict = COVERED with no exclusions or flags. Endorsement LMI-END-61 mandates OEM parts for vehicles 5 model years or newer (2022 Accord qualifies). Endorsement LMI-END-44 waives the $500 deductible upon subrogation recovery. Rental reimbursement is available at $40/day up to $1,200 maximum.

damage_position.summary: Photo assessment (14 photos, confidence 0.91) confirms moderate rear-end damage consistent with the FNOL narrative: rear bumper cover (puncture/tear, severity 0.72), rear bumper reinforcement (bent, 0.60), right tail lamp (shattered, 0.80), trunk lid (dent/misalignment, 0.48), and rear body panel (pushed in 1–2 cm, 0.45). Structural damage is flagged (rear body panel deformation) but trunk floor and rails show no buckling. Rear radar/BSI sensors mounted behind the bumper cover are affected, requiring post-repair calibration. No damage was detected forward of the rear doors — hood and front bumper cover show no new damage. Pre-existing stone chips on the hood leading edge are noted as unrelated normal wear. Total-loss is NOT indicated: projected repair cost $3,642.23 vs. ACV $24,300 = repair-to-ACV ratio of 0.15, well below the 0.75 threshold.

estimate_review.summary: Of 10 estimate lines, 7 are SUPPORTED, 1 is ADMINISTRATIVE (L10, $45 misc/hazmat), and 2 are NOT SUPPORTED BY DAMAGE: L8 Front bumper cover refinish ($240) and L9 Hood repair ($124) — the damage assessment explicitly lists both areas as having no new damage. Two required operations are MISSING from the estimate: rear radar/BSI sensor calibration (RDR-CAL, $250) and pre/post-repair diagnostic scan (SCAN-PP, $125), both mandated by OEM position statement whenever the rear bumper cover is replaced. Net pre-tax adjustment is +$11 (unsupported $364 removed, missing $375 added). All parts in the estimate are already listed as OEM, consistent with endorsement LMI-END-61.

next_actions.action: Issue adjusted repair authorization to Northgate Collision Center: remove L8 ($240) and L9 ($124); add RDR-CAL ($250) and SCAN-PP ($125). Confirm all parts are OEM per endorsement LMI-END-61.
next_actions.rationale: Estimate reconciliation shows two unsupported lines and two missing required ADAS operations. Net adjustment is +$11 pre-tax. OEM parts endorsement applies to this 2022 vehicle.

next_actions.action: Open formal subrogation demand against Granite Ridge Auto Insurance (claim GR-7731-0045) for the full adjusted repair amount plus the $500 deductible. Attach Fairview PD report FPD-26-11873 citing Sloan for ORC 4511.34.
next_actions.rationale: At-fault driver Derek Sloan was cited by police. Endorsement LMI-END-44 waives the insured's $500 deductible upon subrogation recovery. Third-party carrier has not yet accepted liability.

next_actions.action: Activate rental reimbursement for Maya Okafor at $40/day up to $1,200 maximum. Estimated repair cycle is 6 days = $240, well within the cap.
next_actions.rationale: Rental reimbursement is available per policy. Estimated repair days = 6 (6 x $40 = $240, within the $1,200 maximum).

next_actions.action: Confirm with Northgate Collision Center that post-repair BSI/radar calibration (RDR-CAL) is completed and documented before vehicle is returned to insured.
next_actions.rationale: Rear radar/BSI sensors are affected and require OEM-mandated calibration after bumper cover replacement. Safety system must be verified operational.

next_actions.action: Resolve overdue SLA checkpoint: estimate review was due 2026-10-09 and has not been met as of 2026-10-13. Document completion of review in the claim file.
next_actions.rationale: SLA shows estimate_review_met = false. Timely review is required for compliance and customer service standards.

next_actions.action: Notify insured of adjusted estimate, deductible obligation ($500, waivable upon subrogation recovery), rental activation, and expected 6-day repair timeline.
next_actions.rationale: Transparent communication with insured on scope changes, deductible waiver conditions, and rental entitlement.

next_actions.action: Monitor for supplement risk: structural damage flag and ADAS involvement create moderate supplement probability. Request shop to flag any hidden damage discovered during disassembly before proceeding.
next_actions.rationale: Severity indicators flag STRUCTURAL_DAMAGE and ADAS_OR_SRS_AFFECTED. Hidden damage risk is rated low but not zero; rear body panel deformation warrants disassembly inspection.

risk_flags.flag: ADAS/SRS SYSTEMS AFFECTED — Rear radar/BSI sensors require post-repair calibration; missing from shop estimate. Safety liability risk if vehicle returned without calibration.
STRUCTURAL DAMAGE FLAGGED — Rear body panel deformation noted; trunk floor and rails show no buckling but supplement risk exists upon disassembly.
UNSUPPORTED ESTIMATE LINES — L8 (front bumper refinish, $240) and L9 (hood repair, $124) have no corresponding damage in the photo assessment. Possible scope creep or administrative error by shop.
SLA BREACH — Estimate review SLA was due 2026-10-09; not met as of 2026-10-13 (4 days overdue).
THIRD-PARTY LIABILITY PENDING — Granite Ridge Auto Insurance has not yet accepted liability (GR-7731-0045). Subrogation recovery and deductible waiver are contingent on acceptance.

Photo assessment confidence is 0.91 with 14 photos of good quality. Reconciliation is clear: 7 of 10 lines supported, 2 unsupported with explicit damage-area evidence, 2 missing operations with OEM mandate. No fraud indicators, no injuries, no prior losses on the VIN. The only uncertainty is third-party liability acceptance, which affects subrogation timing but not the first-party repair decision.
